en: Changed `/logout` in a background session, which had no effect: it now signs out every session on the computer, deletes stored MCP logins and plugin secrets, and ends the session, as in a terminal
zh: 变更了后台 session 中的 `/logout`（此前无效）：现在它会退出该计算机上的所有 session，删除已存储的 MCP 登录信息和 plugin 密钥，并结束该 session，与终端中一致
